pages.title: Architecture review · 2026-08-30
pages.text:
Architecture review
Date: 2026-08-30. Attendees: Mira, Ravi, Kofi, Ana.
Notes
Ravi compared Postgres and MongoDB for the new ledger service.
A transfer updates several account balances at once.
Mongo was faster to prototype; Postgres won on correctness.
Decisions
We chose Postgres over MongoDB for the ledger, because every transfer must update several balances in one transaction and constraints have to stop a ledger that does not balance. The team also already runs Postgres in production.
MongoDB stays for the analytics event store.
Action items
Ravi drafts the ledger schema with double-entry tables.
